senses.en_definition: To go along with someone; to join in or take part.
To imitate someone or follow their example.
To obey instructions, heed advice, or adhere to teachings or beliefs.
To follow a route or go by way of a particular place.
According to; in accordance with a particular standard or set of circumstances.
(Colloquial) By a particular means of transport.

messages.en: We're heading to the night market after Maghrib prayers. Wanna come along?
I'm in! Give me a sec, I'm getting ready.
Okay, I'll pick you up at your place in a bit.
I've opened the form, but I'm not sure how to fill in this section.
Just follow the steps in the picture, okay? If anything's unclear, ask me.
My dream is to open my own bookshop. For now, I'm saving up.
That's a great idea! When you open it, I want to be your first customer.

senses.en_definition: Beautiful or lovely; pleasing to the senses or the mind.

messages.en: I just sent you the sunset photo I took earlier. Have a look.
Wow, the view there is gorgeous! Where did you take that?
Just at the beach near my place. The sky was absolutely gorgeous this evening.
